name: 14a a workflow tool step runs in bypass instead of through the engine
old:
async tool(name, args, signal) {
      const runtime = await open();
new:
async tool(name, args, signal) {
      const runtime = await open({ bypassPermissions: true });

name: 14b a plugin MCP server is started without its wrapper
old: const wrapped = sandbox.wrap([command, ...(server.args ?? [])].map(shellQuote).join(' '), { cwd: plugin.dir, env });
new: const wrapped = { file: command, args: server.args ?? [] };

name: 14c a plugin process gets the whole process environment
old: const parts = pluginParts(loaded.plugins, { projectRoot, sandboxSettings, envFor: (passthrough) => envFor(passthrough) });
new: const parts = pluginParts(loaded.plugins, { projectRoot, sandboxSettings, envFor: () => ({ ...process.env } as Record<string, string>) });

new: if (errors.length) reports.push(...errors.slice(0, 20).map((item) => formatDiagnostic(path.relative(workRoot, path.resolve(workRoot, file)), item)));
